reading_cards_insert.name: reading_cards_insert
reading_cards_insert.withCheck: "reading_cards"."user_id" = (select auth.uid()) and exists (select 1 from "readings" r where r.id = "reading_cards"."reading_id" and r.user_id = (select auth.uid()))

reading_cards_update.name: reading_cards_update
reading_cards_update.withCheck: "reading_cards"."user_id" = (select auth.uid()) and exists (select 1 from "readings" r where r.id = "reading_cards"."reading_id" and r.user_id = (select auth.uid()))

interpretations_insert.name: interpretations_insert
interpretations_insert.withCheck: "interpretations"."user_id" = (select auth.uid()) and exists (select 1 from "readings" r where r.id = "interpretations"."reading_id" and r.user_id = (select auth.uid()))

interpretations_update.name: interpretations_update
interpretations_update.withCheck: "interpretations"."user_id" = (select auth.uid()) and exists (select 1 from "readings" r where r.id = "interpretations"."reading_id" and r.user_id = (select auth.uid()))

interpretations_complete_check.name: interpretations_complete_check
interpretations_complete_check.value: "interpretations"."status" <> 'complete' or ("interpretations"."synthesis" is not null and "interpretations"."per_card" is not null and "interpretations"."combined" is not null and "interpretations"."reflective_prompts" is not null and "interpretations"."model_id" is not null)

question_embeddings_update.name: question_embeddings_update
question_embeddings_update.withCheck: "question_embeddings"."user_id" = (select auth.uid()) and ("question_embeddings"."reading_id" is null or exists (select 1 from "readings" r where r.id = "question_embeddings"."reading_id" and r.user_id = (select auth.uid())))
